correctness.rationale: A complete proof establishes the upper bound by convex cycle layers and the lower bound by three disjoint s-column windows. For same-window endpoints, the route has two moves of length |a-b| and is unoccupied internally. For distinct-window endpoints, the formula t-2D >=0 follows from h=floor(t/3)>=2s and 0<=r<=2, so the chosen gap-crossing arc is shortest; an empty-column vertical move removes every selected internal vertex. The actual packaged verifier checked 89 (s,t) values and 26,904 vertex pairs by both route checking and independently recomputed BFS distances. Finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: The primary 2024 study identifies exact cylindrical mutual visibility outside certain regimes as an explicit conjecture. This theorem supplies a dimension-uniform proof of sharpness in the unbounded two-parameter wedge t>=6s for s>=3, with a simple reusable three-window geodesic construction. It is a mathematically motivated exact infinite-family partial solution, not an arbitrary numerical instance or a tiny constant improvement; it does not claim the full conjecture or an optimal threshold.
